[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended a Korean-Style Gochujang Marinade for grilled chicken breasts, including ingredients like soy sauce, gochujang, garlic, brown sugar, and ginger.  
[PREFERENCE] User has had gochujang in Korean dishes before and loves its sweet and spicy flavor.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for using gochujang, including starting with a small amount, mixing it with other ingredients, and adjusting the heat level.
